tasks.//mobile-check: This crate exists only for the two mobile triples, so the host-target lint/fmt/test tasks below prove it compiles but not that it LINKS where it ships. Same reasoning as loca-core-rs: deliberately not named `check`, because the iOS half needs a macOS runner with Xcode and would fail the ubuntu job. CI covers the android half.
tasks.mobile-check: cargo check -q -p loca-core-ffi --target aarch64-apple-ios && cargo check -q -p loca-core-ffi --target aarch64-linux-android
